audience: sales and service teams that run leads, accounts, orders and stock in Agiliron

useCases.title: Review leads, tasks and notes
useCases.text: List leads and tasks, filtered or shown with a custom view. Read the notes attached to CRM records.

useCases.title: Check quotes and orders
useCases.text: List quotes, sales orders and purchase orders to vendors. Filter them or use a custom view.

useCases.title: Check product stock and vendors
useCases.text: Read one product by its product code, with its stock levels. Read one vendor by its id.

useCases.title: Check the balance of an account
useCases.text: List the CRM accounts, then read the credit and amount due for one account.

useCases.title: Add a lead or a task
useCases.text: Create a CRM lead or a task from a JSON record in the shape the Agiliron docs give.

useCases.title: Update a contact
useCases.text: Update a CRM contact. The vendor requires all writable fields of the record, so read the record first.
